activationPolicy.dependencyRule: no dependency until product route and rollback are clear

surfaces.purpose: Keep repo edits scoped, reviewable, reversible, and branch-safe.
surfaces.activationRule: Use for code, documentation, quality, and release changes inside UIXAppTTR.

surfaces.purpose: Preserve premium UI rhythm, responsive polish, accessibility, and visual consistency.
surfaces.activationRule: Use when app, web UI, navigation, content hierarchy, or design-system surfaces change.

surfaces.purpose: Govern cinematic motion, reduced-motion behavior, parallax, depth, and future 3D readiness.
surfaces.activationRule: Use after motion evidence and mobile ergonomics gates are green; avoid heavy runtime additions by default.

surfaces.purpose: Write server-side status markers and support authenticated push or PR flow when local GitHub auth is ready.
surfaces.activationRule: Use connector markers when local gh auth is missing; use git push only after auth is verified.

surfaces.purpose: Prepare server, Cloudflare, Vercel, and static deployment handoff without live deploy by default.
surfaces.activationRule: Use only after server target, document root, deployment method, and rollback path are explicit.

surfaces.purpose: Keep many-language lanes as lightweight contracts, starters, and documentation until a service is justified.
surfaces.activationRule: Use for tiny language lanes only; no runtime service until a product route and server target exist.

surfaces.purpose: Translate large AI-native prompts into scoped implementation, reports, automation, and governance updates.
surfaces.activationRule: Use when prompts affect repo governance, automation, long-term planning, or multi-agent workflow.

surfaces.purpose: Preserve secret safety, dependency restraint, publish readiness, and deployment guardrails.
surfaces.activationRule: Use before remote publication, server upload, connector activation, or dependency changes.

rules: All plugin and skill work lands in UIXAppTTR.
Each plugin or skill surface must map to an existing sub-agent.
Connector usage must produce a local report, status marker, or handoff note.
No plugin may add dependencies without a rollback path and quality gates.
GitHub server writes use connector markers until local gh auth is ready.
Cloud or server deployment connectors stay blocked until target details are explicit.
